## How do I install Ironbooks?

<a id="install-ironbooks"></a>

Download the Windows installer from the latest release and double-click it. It installs for your Windows user only, with no admin password, and puts an Ironbooks icon on the Desktop and in the Start Menu.

1. Download Ironbooks-Setup-x.y.z.exe from the latest release on GitHub (github.com/RealDealCPA-VR/Ironbooks/releases/latest). The portable Ironbooks-x.y.z.exe runs without installing.
2. Double-click it. If Windows says "Windows protected your PC", check that the publisher reads RealDealCPA.Ai LLC, then choose More info and Run anyway.
3. Ironbooks opens when the installer finishes. From then on, use the Ironbooks icon on your Desktop.

> Good to know: macOS and Linux: build it from the source code for now (see INSTALL.md).
>
> Good to know: Ironbooks keeps itself up to date and asks before it updates. Check by hand with Help > Check for Updates….

*In the app: Help & Glossary → "How do I install Ironbooks?", or ask Ask AI.*

## How do I create a new company?

<a id="create-company"></a>

Choose "Create a new company…" on the start screen (or File > New Company…), pick where the company file is saved, then answer the Setup Interview. Only the company name is required.

**Where:** **Setup › Setup Interview** (`/onboarding`)

1. On the start screen choose "Create a new company…", or in the menu File > New Company….
2. Choose a name and a folder for the company file, for example "Acme Plumbing.ironbooks" in Documents.
3. Work through the Setup Interview: Company, Industry, Tax form, Dates, Features, Balances, Finish. Use Back to change an answer; you can skip and fill in the rest later. → **Setup › Setup Interview** (`/onboarding`)
4. On the last step click "Go to Home". A starter Chart of Accounts for your industry is ready. → **Home** (`/dashboard`)

> Good to know: Run the interview again any time from Help > Run Setup Interview….

*In the app: Help & Glossary → "How do I create a new company?", or ask Ask AI.*

## What is the company file, and how do I open it?

<a id="company-file"></a>

Each company is one file, for example "Acme Plumbing.ironbooks", like a QuickBooks .QBW. Keep it wherever you like: this computer, a USB drive or the office file server.

**Where:** **Setup › Company File** (`/company-file`)

1. Open it with File > Open or Restore Company… (Ctrl+O), from File > Open Previous Company, or by double-clicking the file.
2. Ironbooks saves your work into the file a few seconds after each change and when you close it. The title bar says Saved.
3. Everyone signs in with their own user name and password every time the file is opened. They are stored in the file, so they go wherever it goes.
4. Copy it, back it up or send it to your accountant like any other file, or use "Save a copy…". → **Setup › Company File** (`/company-file`)

*In the app: Help & Glossary → "What is the company file, and how do I open it?", or ask Ask AI.*

## How do I find a screen or a task quickly?

<a id="find-a-screen"></a>

Press Ctrl+K anywhere and type what you want to do in plain words, such as "I got paid" or "pay a bill". The search box above the menu finds any screen by its name or its QuickBooks name.

**Where:** **Help & Glossary** (`/help`)

1. Press Ctrl+K and type the task. Pick the suggestion and the right screen opens, often with the form already started.
2. Or type in the search box at the top of the left menu. It knows QuickBooks names too, for example "Finance Charges".
3. Press ? on any page for the keyboard shortcuts. The round ? bubble beside a page title explains what that page is for.
4. Still stuck? Open Help & Glossary, or click Ask AI in the top bar and ask in your own words. → **Help & Glossary** (`/help`)

*In the app: Help & Glossary → "How do I find a screen or a task quickly?", or ask Ask AI.*

## Where are all the other screens? (Simple and All menus)

<a id="simple-advanced-menu"></a>

The left menu has two styles. Simple shows only everyday tasks. All menus shows every screen, grouped like the QuickBooks menus. Switch with the Simple / All menus control at the top of the menu.

**Where:** **Setup › My Preferences** (`/my-preferences`)

1. At the top of the left menu, click "All menus" (or "Show all menus…" at the bottom of the Simple menu). Click "Simple" to go back.
2. The same choice is "Menu style" in My Preferences, where All menus is called Advanced. → **Setup › My Preferences** (`/my-preferences`)
3. In either style, search (Ctrl+K or the menu search box) reaches every screen.

> Good to know: A screen can also be missing because its feature is switched off in Preferences, or because your role may not open it.

*In the app: Help & Glossary → "Where are all the other screens? (Simple and All menus)", or ask Ask AI.*

## How do I turn a feature on or off (payroll, inventory, sales tax…)?

<a id="turn-features-on"></a>

Features are switched in Preferences. A feature that is off is hidden from the menus. The Setup Interview sets them when the company is made.

**Where:** **Setup › Preferences** (`/settings`)

1. Open Preferences and pick the category on the left, for example Payroll & Employees. → **Setup › Preferences** (`/settings`)
2. Open the Company Preferences tab, change the setting and save.
3. Or run the Setup Interview again and change your answers on the Features step. → **Setup › Setup Interview** (`/onboarding`)

> Good to know: Only someone who may change company settings can switch features.

*In the app: Help & Glossary → "How do I turn a feature on or off (payroll, inventory, sales tax…)?", or ask Ask AI.*

## What should I work on first each day?

<a id="what-to-do-first"></a>

Open "Needs attention". It lists everything waiting on you, most urgent first: bank lines to sort, late customers, bills due, reconciling, payroll taxes, to-dos and backups.

**Where:** **Needs attention** (`/attention`)

1. Open Needs attention and work down the list. → **Needs attention** (`/attention`)
2. Use the button on each line (Sort it, Send reminder, Pay, Done). Not now? Choose Later to snooze or dismiss it.
3. Home shows the same list plus an Overview of how money moves. Click any step there to do it. → **Home** (`/dashboard`)

*In the app: Help & Glossary → "What should I work on first each day?", or ask Ask AI.*

## How do I enter opening balances?

<a id="opening-balances"></a>

The Setup Interview has a Balances step: enter what each bank, credit card, loan and other account held on your start date. Moving from QuickBooks? Import your history instead and the balances come with it.

**Where:** **Setup › Setup Interview** (`/onboarding`)

1. Open the Setup Interview and go to the Balances step. → **Setup › Setup Interview** (`/onboarding`)
2. Check the "Balances as of" date, then add each account and its balance with "Add an account".
3. Finish the interview. Ironbooks records the balances as one opening entry.
4. Coming from QuickBooks: use Migrate from QuickBooks, which brings in your accounts, history and open invoices and bills. → **Setup › Migrate from QuickBooks** (`/qb-import`)

*In the app: Help & Glossary → "How do I enter opening balances?", or ask Ask AI.*
